items.label: Profile
items.content: AI immersive technologist and XR product leader with 9+ years designing and shipping immersive, AI-driven educational experiences that turn complex scientific data into interactive, explorable worlds. Founded Adventure Portal, translating real NASA/JPL and James Webb Space Telescope mission data into free-roam VR, piloted at the Telus World of Science and signed by a VR-arcade publisher for distribution across its 400+ arcade network. Builds end-to-end production pipelines that pair real-time 3D (Unity, WebXR) with generative-AI ecosystems (Claude, ComfyUI, n8n) to create immersive content at scale, and has stood up an entire XR development department (pipelines, hiring, and partner delivery) for institutional clients. Hands-on builder and technical lead, equally at home in engine code and a project plan.

jobs.title: Founder & Principal Technologist
bullets: Founded an XR software platform that turns real scientific data into free-roam, exploration-driven educational experiences, translating James Webb Space Telescope and NASA/JPL mission data into interactive VR worlds.
Ran the experience as a paid pilot at the Telus World of Science: 603 guests, 73.5% utilization, 4.84/5 satisfaction, NPS 84.
Signed a publishing deal with Synthesis VR placing the experience for distribution across its network of 400+ VR arcades.

Built end-to-end production pipelines integrating generative AI (Claude API, ComfyUI) and n8n automation into content creation and operations, accelerating output and unlocking new immersive storytelling formats.
Architected real-time multiplayer VR in Unity (FishNet networking, ownership transfer, NetworkTransform, ScriptableObject architecture).
Direct external operators and creative partners under performance-gated licensing structures; invited to speak on location-based entertainment at GamesCon Canada.

header.name: Brayden Clark
header.title: AI Immersive Technologist · XR & Real-Time 3D · Generative-AI Production Pipelines

body: I'm applying for the AI Immersive Technologist role because turning real scientific data into experiences people can step inside is the exact problem I've spent the last several years solving. With Adventure Portal, I built an XR platform that translates NASA/JPL and James Webb Space Telescope mission data into free-roam VR worlds, the same leap from raw science to public wonder that OceanX makes from the deep ocean.

I ship end to end. I piloted Adventure Portal as a paid experience at the Telus World of Science (603 guests, 73.5% utilization, 4.84/5 satisfaction, NPS 84), signed a publishing deal placing it for distribution across Synthesis VR's network of 400+ VR arcades, and built the pipeline behind it, pairing real-time Unity multiplayer with generative-AI tooling (Claude API, ComfyUI, n8n) to produce immersive content at a pace a small team can sustain. Earlier I stood up an entire XR development department for an institutional client, from pipelines and tech stack to hiring and partner delivery.

What draws me to OceanX specifically is the rare combination of frontier science and world-class storytelling on the same vessel. That is the work I want to do: making the inaccessible feel immediate, accurate, and worth caring about. I'd welcome the chance to bring my XR engineering and AI production experience aboard and help shape how OceanX's discoveries reach the world.
